rationale: manhart_pwls_tv-claude-agentic: val_n=200, pwls_gamma=1.0, pwls_weight_norm=mean, tv_lambda=0.004, tv_iterations=1000, tv_lr=0.01, tv_decay=0.01, tv_optimizer=gd, tv_init=fbp, rationale=iter-8 LAMBDA sweep up. iter-7 tv_lambda 0.001->0.002 jumped hr 0.2763->0.3552 (ssim 0.9814->0.9909) at 1000 iters — TV was underweighted; stronger TV is strongly productive and not yet over-smoothing. ONE knob: tv_lambda 0.002->0.004 (2x), iterations kept 1000, gamma=1.0. HYPOTHESIS: if hr rises past 0.3552 TV is still underweighted (keep climbing lambda); if hr drops (over-smoothing loses fine breast structure) the optimum is between 2e-3 and 4e-3 and I bisect (~3e-3). Budget: iter-7 860s at 1000 iters -> ~860s, <1200s wall.
